title: GlioMODA
description: Segment gliomas on atlas-registered brain MRI with GlioMODA (BraTS labels).

segment.title: Segment tumour
segment.description: Return the BraTS label map (1 necrotic core, 2 oedema, 3 enhancing tumour) and a volume table, using the GlioMODA model for the supplied sequences.

t1c.description: Optional T1 contrast-enhanced image, skull-stripped on the 240 x 240 x 155 BraTS/SRI24 grid

t2f.description: Optional T2 FLAIR image, skull-stripped on the 240 x 240 x 155 BraTS/SRI24 grid

t1n.description: Optional T1 native image, skull-stripped on the 240 x 240 x 155 BraTS/SRI24 grid

t2w.description: Optional T2-weighted image, skull-stripped on the 240 x 240 x 155 BraTS/SRI24 grid

mirror.description: Average the 7 mirrored passes of each patch, as nnU-Net and the GlioMODA container do

resEncL.description: Use the ResEncL model; needs all four sequences

backend.description: Requested inference backend; WebGPU failures fall back to WASM CPU.
